task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Formulate MaxCut on the graph with edges [(0, 1), (0, 2), (0, 4), (0, 5), (0, 6), (1, 2), (1, 3), (1, 6), (2, 4), (2, 6), (3, 5), (3, 6), (4, 5), (5, 6)] as a QUBO with dimod and solve it with SimulatedAnnealingSampler from dwave-samplers. Verify against brute force. Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
